name: Crunchyroll Importer
summary: Turn a Crunchyroll season into ComicK episodes.

scripts.title: Format episodes
scripts.summary: Writes data/output.txt from the response, and downloads the preview images next to it.

fields.label: Keep Crunchyroll's episode numbers
fields.hint: Use the numbers Crunchyroll shows, like 49 to 72, instead of restarting the season at 1.

fields.label: Skip downloading preview images
fields.hint: Faster, but the episodes get uploaded without a preview image. Previews are optional on ComicK.

scripts.title: Upload to ComicK
scripts.summary: Sends the episodes to an anime. Episodes already on ComicK are skipped and listed.

fields.label: Anime
fields.hint: Paste the anime's ComicK link or type its slug.

fields.label: Moderator note
fields.appended: Auto Uploaded using ComicK Crunchyroll Importer. (https://github.com/Russhvith/comick-tools)
fields.placeholder: Anything reviewers should know about this batch

fields.label: Dry run, upload nothing
fields.hint: Run every check and list what would be uploaded, without sending anything to ComicK.

fields.label: Upload without asking first
fields.hint: Skip the confirmation in the console and start uploading straight away.

files.label: Crunchyroll response
files.hint: Paste the season episodes response here
